content.aboutMe: Computer Engineer and Full Stack Developer with experience in web development, cloud deployments, and process optimization. I work with Node.js, Vue.js, relational databases, and GCP, integrating Business Intelligence, automation, and AI into business-oriented solutions. Interested in product development and agile methodologies.

xp.content: Development and maintenance of full-stack web solutions (Node.js/Express, Vue.js, PHP, PostgreSQL/MySQL).;Implementation of real-time applications (Vue.js, WebSockets) and landing pages.;Collaboration with clients on requirements gathering and technical support for internal applications.;Management of deployments, Nginx configuration, and database updates on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
xp.skills: Node.js · Express · Vue.js · PHP · PostgreSQL · MySQL · WebSockets · GCP · Nginx

xp.content: Participate in requirements gathering for a web platform for a pharmacy/laboratory.;Collaborate with a team on platform development, focusing on quality control and drug batch analysis modules.
xp.skills: Requirements Analysis · Software Development · Quality Control Systems

xp.content: Develop automated flows with Power Automate for managing communications based on Microsoft forms.;Create and maintain Power BI dashboards for monitoring courses and students.;Maintain and develop a full-stack chatbot integrated with OpenAI API.;Design and implement custom tools to optimize operational processes.
xp.skills: Power BI · Power Automate · OpenAI API · Process Optimization

xp.content: Develop and maintain web applications using Vue.js for various companies, including Bboch and Sierra Gorda.;Create landing pages for clients like Copec, KCP, and LAN.;Participate in the initial development of an ERP-type web application, working closely with multidisciplinary teams.;Apply methodologies adapted from Scrum and Lean in the development process.
xp.skills: Vue.js · JavaScript · Scrum · Lean · Web Development
